from typing import List

class Solution:
    def maximumSetSize(self, nums1: List[int], nums2: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums1)
        k = n // 2
        s1 = set(nums1)
        s2 = set(nums2)
        common = len(s1 & s2)
        only1 = len(s1) - common
        only2 = len(s2) - common
        x = min(only1, k)
        y = min(only2, k)
        remaining = (k - x) + (k - y)
        return x + y + min(common, remaining)

class Solution:
    def maximumSetSize(self, nums1: List[int], nums2: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums1)
        k = n // 2
        s1 = set(nums1)
        s2 = set(nums2)
        both = len(s1 & s2)
        only1 = len(s1) - both
        only2 = len(s2) - both
        u1 = min(only1, k)
        u2 = min(only2, k)
        r = (k - u1) + (k - u2)
        return u1 + u2 + min(both, r)
